info.title: 手刻 PCA 與 sklearn digits 驗證

parts.text: 用 sklearn digits 手刻 PCA，取前 10 個主成分，然後確認它是對的。

**Verifying PCA Implementation**

I've initiated the development of a manual PCA implementation, focusing on the `digits` dataset from `sklearn`. My objective is to extract the top 10 principal components without utilizing the pre-built PCA class. Right now, I am verifying the correctness of the PCA implementation.
